title: Sliding Window Maximum
prompt: You are given an array of integers nums, there is a sliding window of size k which is moving from the very left of the array to the very right. You can only see the k numbers in the window. Each time the sliding window moves right by one position. Return the max sliding window.
hints: Use a monotonically decreasing deque. Store indices (not values) so we can check if the max is still in the window.
The front of the deque is always the max of the current window. When we add a new element, pop from the back until the back >= new element.
When the front index is outside the window (i - front >= k), pop from front.
O(n) - each element pushed and popped at most once.
